messages:
Mike (CS): quick async standup — BlueYonder renewal next week, they flagged adoption gaps after last canary. main blockers: embeddings mismatch + occasional rate-limit 429s.
Anya (PM): thanks Mike. can you paste the latest error samples? i want to show product impact to ESM.
Mike (CS): paste from their logs: `2026-03-15T09:12:34Z ERROR embedding mismatch: id 0x7a -> vector dims 1535 (expected 1536)` and a couple of `HTTP 429: rate limit exceeded` spikes around 9:10-9:20 PST.
Jordan (Eng): noted. 429s likely from autoscale cooldown + client burst. embeddings dim off-by-one looks like preprocessing mismatch on their side or quantization rounding. asked for sample payload in last ping.
Nora (CS): @Jordan posted the sample payload in the ticket (CS-1129) — happy to forward. customer is running a custom tokenizer via our SDK wrapper.
Jordan (Eng): okay forward it. quick plan: 1) triage embedding dims locally with their payload, 2) add defensive validation on our side to surface clear error instead of silent truncation, 3) recommend rolling back their custom tokenizer until we validate.
Sam (SRE): for the 429s — can we check Anycast pool contention + recent config bump? I saw a short surge at 09:15 that correlated with a canary.
OpsBot: deploy 2612-prod-canary started by deploybot at 2026-03-15T08:58:21Z; completed on 2026-03-15T09:06:02Z.
Jordan (Eng): that canary included the batching change; might have increased brief queueing. i'll check batch sizing and cooldown.
Anya (PM): timeline: customer exec ask on call Friday. can we have a verified mitigation before then? 
Mike (CS): target: mitigation by Thursday EOD. i'll schedule a quick sync with BlueYonder for Wednesday to align on rollback if needed.
Jordan (Eng): blockers: need their sample payload + access to their embedding outputs (even a scrubbed dump). once we have that, i'll reproduce and open PR for validation + error message.
Nora (CS): forwarding scrubbed payload now in CS-1129 comment. also adding their permission to share anonymized vectors.
Jordan (Eng): got it. i'll start local repro. pinging @Sam for any logs around 09:10-09:25 so we can correlate.
Sam (SRE): pulling logs for that window now — will attach latency/cpu/gpu queue charts to the ticket in ~20m.
Anya (PM): also, small CR ping: Jordan can you review my product doc update re: rollback playbook? link in the ticket.
Jordan (Eng): will review in ~30m. if it's lightweight i'll approve.
Mike (CS): action items summary: Mike -> schedule Wed sync; Nora -> share scrubbed payload (done); Jordan -> repro + PR for defensive validation; Sam -> logs/charts; Anya -> update rollback doc.
Nora (CS): adding customer note: they want a short explanation we can send to legal about data handling for the scrubbed dump. i'll draft.
Jordan (Eng): quick note: for defensive check we can add a small snippet to the server side:
```
if (embedding.length != expectedDims) {
  return 400, "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536";
}
```
Sam (SRE): +1. that'll make the failure mode clearer and reduce retries that trigger 429s.
Anya (PM): perfect. Mike — do you want me on the Wed call? happy to represent product and present rollback options.
Mike (CS): yes please, @Anya — that'd help. thanks everyone. 
Jordan (Eng): leaving a CR review ping flag on PR #4487; will tag cs and pm once ready.
OpsBot: reminder: weekly-cs-sync scheduled 2026-03-17T16:00:00Z.
Nora (CS): last: i'll draft the customer-facing note + legal blurb and drop it in CS-1129.
Mike (CS): closing loop here — i'll post a short status update after the Wed sync. :thumbsup:
